name: Rimu Asakura
source:
Rimu is both Souka's cousin and close friend. She's had a very outspoken crush on Taru for a long time, and won't deny she wishes her cousin and crush would just break up already. However, though she has a clear short temper, she's a very spirited and kind girl overall. She seems to get along well with the group despite her personal agenda.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25920]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
